body:
Our Water Infrastructure Project Experience

Tongyang has been deeply involved in water supply and wastewater treatment EPC projects, supporting engineering coordination and industrial equipment supply. Our experience covers raw-water intake, water treatment, municipal wastewater treatment and industrial zero-liquid discharge systems.

Selected Projects

  • Yanzidi Water Plant Renovation Project — Raw-water intake, pumping and associated water infrastructure.

  • Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source Project — Emergency raw-water intake and supply facilities.

  • Dafeng Tongyu River Intake Upgrade and Enhanced Pretreatment Project — Water intake improvement and pretreatment.

  • Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant, Tianfu New Area — Municipal wastewater treatment facilities.

  • Huaneng Zhengning Mine-Water Deep Treatment and ZLD Project — Industrial wastewater treatment, evaporation and crystallization; equipment references include storage tanks and heat exchangers.

Our participation focuses on defined engineering and equipment scopes in collaboration with project partners.
